source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将破，静雷已至
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC29 after EP02 SC28 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the final instant before release into the next threshold: Keshadu's suspicion is nearly irreversible, Shisilang's fury has become a destabilizing force, Tuobaye is at the edge of collapse, and the white-clothed woman's restraint is no longer something that can plausibly hold much longer.
title: 真相将破，静雷已至

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC28 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC28 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相欲出，十四郎怒势将崩，拓拔野极限将断，白衣女子的静雷已到将炸边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这一切从将炸推进到几乎无法逆转。科沙度的判断已近乎既成事实，十四郎的失控会让表面局势更容易破裂，拓拔野已快没有余力再支撑，而白衣女子的克制已经来到最后可维持的一线。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把这条线推进到真正无法再维持表面平衡的状态，为明确爆点或出手做最后前置。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained until the source beat truly forces action; no gratuitous overt spell spectacle ahead of the real break.
Keshadu should feel like the truth is already functionally known, even if not fully declared.
Shisilang remains unstable and combustible from humiliation.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: nearly-exposed truth, failing control, failing endurance, and almost-broken restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
